_comment: Terrain type ids as stored in the live map array (u8, flat w*h, row-major).
Located at 0x02016C2A in one session; the address is map/session specific,
so find it with matchrow() rather than hard-coding it.
Derived from a captured 15x10 map plus the player's reading of row 5. Most
entries are structural rather than asserted -- see 'evidence' on each.
IMPORTANT: these ids agree with the column indices of the movement-cost
tables in aw1_movecost.json, which is what resolves the Mountain/River
ambiguity those tables could not settle on their own.

provenance.method: live RAM capture cross-referenced with the movement tables
provenance.layout: u8, flat, index = y * width + x

1.name: Plain
1.evidence: most common value; movement col 1 is Plain (Tires 2, Treads 1)

2.name: River
2.evidence: player read row 5 as river; fixes movement col 2

3.name: Mountain
3.evidence: two vertical 2-wide ranges; movement col 3 is the other foot-only column, so River at 2 forces Mountain here

4.name: Wood
4.evidence: scattered patches; movement col 4 is Wood (Tires 3, Treads 2)

5.name: Road
5.evidence: forms connected lines at x=1,7,13 meeting the bridges in row 5

6.name: City
6.evidence: PROVISIONAL - small clusters, normal land movement; needs confirming on screen

7.name: Sea
7.evidence: movement table: ships and lander only

8.name: HQ
8.evidence: seen only as 40 and 72, i.e. 8+32 and 8+64, one per player in opposite corners

11.name: Port
11.evidence: movement table: ships, lander and all land units

12.name: Bridge
12.evidence: player read row 5; sits exactly where roads cross the river

13.name: Shoal
13.evidence: movement table: lander yes, ships no

19.name: Reef
19.evidence: movement table: ships and lander at cost 2

unresolved.0: never seen in a live map; likely out-of-bounds
unresolved.9: movement table says air-only, which matches no known AW1 terrain
unresolved.15-18: impassable to everything including air; likely unused slots

needs_confirmation: id 6 assumed City -- could be Base or Airport, all of which move identically
the 32-per-owner ownership step is inferred from two HQ tiles only
no Base or Airport appeared on this map, so their ids are still unknown
